position: Integrated source path ready for private demo
headline: The ask-to-source path is now executable, visible, and testable as one bounded product slice.
copy: Passing checks authorize private demonstration only; they do not authorize production or public launch.

postures.title: Review gate
postures.copy: The backend spike continuation decision and locks are explicit.

postures.title: API reliability
postures.copy: Success and typed failure envelopes are tested.

postures.title: Registry search
postures.copy: Approved, review, hold, and no-source lanes remain separate.

postures.title: Ask demo
postures.copy: The learner surface works in reviewed-preview mode and exposes local mode honestly.

postures.title: Public launch
postures.copy: Security, rights operations, durable identity, privacy, and support remain unfinished.

flow.title: API
flow.copy: Run health, source, error, source-list, and search contracts.

flow.title: UI
flow.copy: Validate Ask demo structure, accessibility labels, and static assets.

flow.title: Regress
flow.copy: Run legacy backend, route, and static-link checks.

decisions.label: Private demo
decisions.reason: The complete bounded source path can be shown locally or in reviewed preview.

decisions.label: Hosted backend
decisions.reason: Production security and operations are not in scope.

decisions.label: Corpus expansion
decisions.reason: Rights-cleared source growth is still required.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: This is a launch-candidate learning slice, not a released service.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed translation or corpus delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private demo readiness does not authorize public launch.
